subject.title: feat(slack): support Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in Slack Enterprise Grid org-install mode with additive delivery-admission and account-sensitive binding hooks in the bundled Slack plugin now?
rationale: The PR adds new Slack config, authorization behavior, fail-closed delivery policy, and plugin/core API surface, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not decide the product/API direction.

options.title: Accept after contract cleanup
options.body: Proceed with the feature after documenting and contract-testing the new hooks, or narrowing them so no public plugin API is added accidentally.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Keep the Slack listener-scoped Enterprise Grid runtime path but internalize or defer the generic plugin hooks until a broader channel-plugin API design is approved.

options.title: Defer org-install support
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the linked issue as the product-design tracker if maintainers prefer the current per-workspace Slack account model for now.

recommendation.title: Accept after contract cleanup
recommendation.body: Proceed with the feature after documenting and contract-testing the new hooks, or narrowing them so no public plugin API is added accidentally.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on Slack config/startup/event authorization behavior, where current history points most strongly to this owner candidate.
